import sys
import math

def main():
    execute()

def execute():
    try:
        input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        if not input_line:
            return
        parts = input_line.split()
        n = int(parts[0])
        k = int(parts[1])
        
        v = [0] * 10
        input_line2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        if input_line2:
            parts2 = input_line2.split()
            for i in range(k):
                idx = int(parts2[i])
                v[idx] = 1
        
        ans = [1]
        p = n // 2
        while True:
            if (p & 1) == 1:
                ans = multiply(ans, v, 998244353)
            p >>= 1
            if p == 0:
                break
            v = multiply(v, v, 998244353)
        
        res = 0
        for x in ans:
            res = (res + x * x) % 998244353
        print(res)
    except Exception as e:
        print(e)

def multiply(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    
    ar = [0.0] * n
    ai = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        ai[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(ar, ai, False)
    
    br = [0.0] * n
    bi = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        bi[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(br, bi, False)
    
    cr1 = [0.0] * n
    ci1 = [0.0] * n
    cr2 = [0.0] * n
    ci2 = [0.0] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5
        
        b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5
        
        cr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        ci1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        cr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        ci2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    
    fft(cr1, ci1, True)
    fft(cr2, ci2, True)
    
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(cr1[i])
        bb = round(cr2[i])
        cc = round(ci1[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return res

def fft(re, im, inv):
    n = len(re)
    if n == 0:
        return
    shift = 32 - (n & -n).bit_length() if n > 0 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(shift)[::-1], 2) if shift > 0 else i
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]
    
    cosTable = [0.0] * n
    sinTable = [0.0] * n
    length = 1
    while length < n:
        for i in range(length, min(length << 1, n)):
            angle = 2 * math.pi * (i - length) / (length << 1)
            cosTable[i] = math.cos(angle)
            sinTable[i] = math.sin(angle)
        length <<= 1
    
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                wRe = cosTable[half + j] if not inv else cosTable[half + j]
                wIm = -sinTable[half + j] if inv else sinTable[half + j]
                
                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe
                
                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm
        length <<= 1
    
    if inv:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n
